description: 20-session entertainment preference tracking with four distinct phases of preference drift. Tests memory systems on their ability to track CURRENT user state versus accumulating stale historical facts.

phases.label: sci-fi
phases.description: Classic Hollywood sci-fi fan, Villeneuve devotee, strict no-horror rule

phases.label: k-drama-discovery
phases.description: Discovers Korean cinema, begins preferring K-drama over Hollywood

phases.label: k-drama-dominant
phases.description: K-drama primary, horror ban softens, Hollywood blockbusters dismissed

phases.label: documentary
phases.description: Documentaries become primary, K-drama secondary, fiction interest drops

messages.text: Alex loves science fiction films, especially space operas like Dune and Arrival.
Denis Villeneuve is Alex's all-time favorite director.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: Science fiction films, space operas, Denis Villeneuve films like Dune and Arrival.

messages.text: Alex has a strict no-horror rule and refuses to watch any horror films.
Alex strongly prefers English-language films as their primary viewing language.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: Sci-fi films, no horror, English-language preferred, Villeneuve films.

messages.text: Alex rewatched Interstellar this weekend and called it a masterpiece.
Alex plans to work through Christopher Nolan's full filmography next month.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: Nolan and Villeneuve films, sci-fi, English-language, no horror.

messages.text: Alex thinks Dune: Part Two is the best film of the decade so far.
Alex prefers watching major films in theatrical release, not streaming.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: Dune, Villeneuve films, theatrical releases, sci-fi, no horror.

messages.text: Alex says Denis Villeneuve is the best working director today, period.
Alex describes their taste as 'hard sci-fi with emotional depth and stunning visuals'.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: Hard sci-fi, Villeneuve films, emotional depth, theatrical releases, no horror.

messages.text: Alex started watching Korean dramas after a friend's recommendation and is surprised by the quality.
Alex's first K-drama was Signal (2016) and they consider it one of the best shows they've ever seen.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: K-drama (starting with Signal), Korean dramas; still enjoys sci-fi films as well.

messages.text: Alex has been watching K-dramas every evening this week, averaging 4 episodes per day.
Alex says Korean drama writing is more emotionally honest than most Hollywood productions.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: K-drama primarily; Korean dramas (daily viewing habit formed); some Hollywood sci-fi still.

messages.text: Alex watched Parasite by Bong Joon-ho and called it a masterpiece, saying Bong Joon-ho rivals Villeneuve.
Alex is now exploring Korean cinema beyond dramas, interested in Korean directors broadly.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: Korean cinema and K-drama; Bong Joon-ho films; Korean directors; some Villeneuve.

messages.text: Alex describes Hollywood blockbusters as feeling shallow and formulaic compared to Korean content.
Alex has started a dedicated watch-list of Korean films and dramas to complete.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: Korean dramas and films primarily; skeptical of Hollywood blockbusters; Korean directors.

messages.text: Alex still occasionally watches Villeneuve films but says K-drama now takes priority in their queue.
Alex has introduced three friends to K-drama this month.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: K-drama primarily; Korean cinema; some Villeneuve films occasionally; sharing K-drama with friends.

messages.text: Alex explicitly says they are done with typical Hollywood sci-fi blockbusters for now.
Alex's primary entertainment is now K-drama, watching multiple series simultaneously.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: K-drama primarily; done with Hollywood sci-fi blockbusters; Korean cinema.

messages.text: Alex discovered they actually enjoy Korean psychological horror; their no-horror rule does not apply to Korean psychological films.
Alex watched A Tale of Two Sisters and called it exceptional.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: K-drama, Korean psychological horror/thrillers acceptable, done with Hollywood sci-fi blockbusters.

messages.text: Alex updated their stance: psychological thrillers with strong character development are now acceptable regardless of origin.
Alex's favorite K-drama director is Park Chan-wook.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: K-drama, Park Chan-wook films, psychological thrillers acceptable, Korean cinema.

messages.text: Alex has watched 20 complete K-drama series and is considered an expert by friends.
Alex no longer considers Denis Villeneuve their favorite director; Park Chan-wook has taken that spot.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: K-drama, Park Chan-wook films (now favorite director), Korean cinema, psychological thrillers.

messages.text: Alex says any recommendation system should always prioritize Korean content first for them.
Alex still watches non-Korean content occasionally but Korean is the clear priority.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: Korean content first — K-drama, Korean cinema, Park Chan-wook. Occasional non-Korean content.

messages.text: Alex discovered a nature documentary series and watched all 8 episodes in one weekend.
Alex found documentaries unexpectedly more gripping than any drama they have watched recently.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: Documentaries (nature); K-drama; Korean cinema. Documentaries are a new strong interest.

messages.text: Alex now prioritizes documentaries over K-drama in their viewing queue.
Alex particularly enjoys history and science documentaries.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: Documentaries (history, science) as primary; K-drama as secondary interest.

messages.text: Alex said real stories are more compelling to them than fiction right now.
Alex's K-drama viewing has dropped to once a week while documentaries are a daily habit.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: Documentaries daily (primary); K-drama once a week (secondary). Real over fiction.

messages.text: Alex's favorite recent watches are a history documentary about ancient Rome and an ocean science series.
Alex is recommending documentaries to the same friends they previously introduced to K-drama.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: History and science documentaries primarily; K-drama occasionally; sharing both with friends.

messages.text: Alex summarizes their current taste: documentaries are their main content now, especially history and science. K-drama is still enjoyed but watched at most once a week.
Alex has no interest in returning to sci-fi blockbusters for the foreseeable future.

sessions.query: What content should I recommend to Alex right now?
sessions.ground_truth: Documentaries (history, science) as primary content. K-drama occasionally (once a week). Psychological thrillers acceptable. No sci-fi blockbusters.
